Kismile Debuts AeroLucen 5QT Glass Air Fryer for Healthier, Faster Cooking

by Jude Chukwuemeka
August 27, 2026
in News
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:28
Instaread

Modern home cooks seeking efficient, health-conscious meal solutions have a new appliance to consider. Small appliance brand Kismile has officially introduced the AeroLucen 5QT Glass Air Fryer, a unit engineered to accelerate cooking times while offering complete visual monitoring of the process.

Advanced Thermal Efficiency and Active Cooling

Powered by a 1500W carbon fiber heating unit, a 3600 RPM high-speed DC motor, and precise PID thermal management, the AeroLucen minimizes preheating requirements and optimizes airflow. For safety and comfort, the integrated Cool-Loop airflow system keeps the touch interface cool during high-heat operation.

Key Features & Operational Capabilities

  • Rapid Speed: Cooks a half-pound of frozen fries in as few as 8 minutes and roasts a whole chicken in 30 minutes without requiring preheating or butchering.
  • Broad Temperature Range: Adjusts from 90°F up to 450°F, accommodating diverse preparation methods from dough proofing to high-heat broiling.
  • Dynamic LED Indicator: Features a top-mounted 4-color animated speed ring (ranging from cyan to red) that changes lighting patterns to reflect current fan speeds and operational modes.

Chemical-Free Borosilicate Glass Construction

The air fryer features a high-borosilicate glass bowl that provides a full 360-degree view of food as it crisps. Built entirely without PFAS chemical nonstick coatings, the glass container eliminates peeling risks and is dishwasher-safe. An included lid allows the cooking vessel to transition directly to the table for serving or to the refrigerator for storage.

Convertible Cooking Space and Compact Build

The unit features Kismile’s proprietary Magic Crisper Plate. Reversing the plate adjusts the internal volume from a full 5-quart capacity down to 2.5 quarts, lifting ingredients closer to the heat source for intense roasting. The entire appliance features a compact 9.7-inch footprint for simple cabinet storage.

See Food While It Cooks

One of the AeroLucen’s standout features is its transparent glass cooking chamber. Users can check the progress of their meals without relying solely on cooking times or repeatedly opening the appliance.

The design provides a more engaging cooking experience while making it easier to monitor food as it browns and reaches the desired level of doneness.

Pricing and Availability

Advertisement

Offered in Pearl and Onyx colorways, the Kismile AeroLucen Glass Air Fryer retails at an MSRP of $159 and is available via Amazon and Kismile’s official site.
